title: Great fun zipping round the city
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our private tour with Zach, zipping round the sites. He took great care of us, including when one of us had a minor mishap involving a lamppost! Recommended as an introduction to Seville.
author: oxonfour

title: Brilliant experience!
text: We had an absolutely amazing private tour with Zach. He was so friendly and knowledgeable. Despite whizzing through busy streets with lots of people, cars and scooters, Zach kept us safe and relaxed throughout. Could not recommend enough, what an interesting tour and fabulous experience!
author: 912alyxp

title: Excellent way to see Seville — easy Segways, great guide
text:
We took the 2-hour Monumental Segway Tour and it was excellent. Our guide was very informative throughout, and took lots of photos of us along the way, which was a nice bonus.

The Segways took very little training and were easy to ride, even for first-timers — we felt comfortable within minutes. A great way to cover a lot of Seville in a short time. Highly recommended.
author: brianmY8787EW

title: A hugely enjoyable tour
text: I hadn't done a segway tour for many years and my friend had never done one. There was a slight delay before we got going but had to complete some paperwork. I understand we were waiting for others to join us but they never showed up so it was just the two of us in the end. We were given clear instructions on how to use the segway and had the opportunity to practise before setting off.  This was our first morning in Seville so it gave us the chance to see a lot in a short time and to help get our bearings in the city while seeing some key sites. author: T705JJkatherineb

title: A fantastic historical tour on Segway
text: A two hour Segway tour around the main sites of Seville city centre. No experience needed, the guide trained us, took us around and gave us a guided tour along the historical facts for the various stops we did. A most enjoyable time with Zack, a young man with a great manner and professionalism. Zack even took photos and videos of us, such great memories. Highly recommended! Thank you Zack!
author: Saba_H

title: Great Tour, Zach was such a great guide!
text: Zach was such a great guide. We had interesting conversations about the history of the city, the key places, the people, even Spain politics. He was quite knowledgeable and I would 100% recommend someone taking a tour with him.
author: Cesar_B

title: 6 ladies on Segways in Seville
text: Excellent experience - great job Antonio. We had so much fun.  Tip - I thought I’d never get it and nearly gave up but within 2 mins was completely comfortable and confident.  Our guide was very patient and went at our pace.  Great way to see Seville.
